//3: Upstream 'removes_effects: venom_weaken' dropped — no such effect in BN.
name: Personal Enhancement
desc: Psionic energy floods your body, raising all four of your attributes.
remove_message: The surge of power fades away.

//2: Nether Attunement display band (spec Rev 3, amended QA round 3): the real meter is a vitamin-scale char var (mom_math.lua); this effect's intensity 0-12 is derived from it on every write. No native int_decay — the Lua 5-minute decay tick in mom_eoc.lua owns the clock and resyncs this intensity.
//3: Upstream per-intensity apply_message array flattened to one string — BN apply_message is a plain string.
name: Nether-Attunement
desc: You feel a little odd and your control over your powers isn't as sure as it was.  There might be unexpected results of you channeling psionics now.
apply_message: You feel a little odd, like you've just awoken from a dream.  All that psionic channeling might have unexpected effects.
decay_messages: The constant hum of power fades, just a little.  It's easier to think now.
The roar of the Nether subsides.  You can finally hear your own thoughts again.
remove_message: You take a deep breath as the strange feelings fade.  You are in full control of your powers once again.
